title: eludite.project.launch_profiles input
description: A project's launch profiles (`Properties/launchSettings.json`), as the Debug property page and the Debug toolbar's profile list show them, with the one F5 uses (`selected`; eludite.debug.start's `profile` overrides it).

project.description: The project: its name as the Workspace window shows it, or the path of its project file (absolute, or relative to the solution folder). Default: the project selected in the Workspace window, else the active document's project, else the startup project.
